name: Damage, then "that creature loses …" / "those creatures can't block" — Vertigo, Soul Sear, Quick Draw, Sparkmage's Gambit
notes: Found by tests/audit.py once a target that is dealt damage was audited through its later "that creature" sentence (2026-11-17). The "loses <keyword>" reader took its subject from the start of the line across the full stop: Vertigo's "… deals 2 damage to target creature with flying. That creature loses flying" became a global effect with a nonsense filter and no target (Soul Sear, Smite the Deathless, Rebel Salvo likewise), and Quick Draw's "Creatures target opponent controls lose first strike and double strike" was read as its first target, so the creature it pumps lost the first strike it gained. Sparkmage's Gambit's "… to each of up to two target creatures. Those creatures can't block this turn" had a picker for one.
